scope: Explicit identifier/package renames and asset GUID remapping; comments/whitespace ignored. Changed tokens and excluded reference integrations are NOT evidence of equivalence.

validation.scope: Shared canonical packages compiled and exercised in Unity 2022.3.62f3 and 6000.0.85f2. Native indirect output is enabled only by the Unity 6 branch; the single-view scope is unchanged.

culling.scope: Reference expectations for generated camera/shadow command flags, LOD/cascade counts, ranges and byte offsets; actual GPU finalization and readback of generated arguments. No native draw submission, full frustum/occlusion culling, or visual comparison.

player_wind.scope: Standalone Player: production beginContextRendering -> CaptureSpeedTreeWind -> renderer-owned matrix-buffer wind region. Every frame poisons and reads back all 32 native current/history vectors. The source prefab is never instantiated or rendered by this fixture. This validates wind capture only; the fixture does not draw GPU Batcher camera geometry. Unity 2022 retains its unavailable native submission boundary; Unity 6 native draw images are validated separately.

validation.remaining_native_gap: Stock Unity 2022 needs an engine binding for native indirect draws. Camera and shadow submissions use BRGIndirectSubmission.submitHandler on either engine.
compatibility_differences: Baked occlusion queries native enclosing spheres through CullingGroup, which can conservatively retain more chunks than the reference AABB query.

Wind uses native Tree proxies with original mesh/LOD topology, two capture passes per unique source and GPU slot copies; integer data lives on proxy materials because native Tree rendering overwrites property blocks.
Native initial wind identity can contain zero branch/leaf values until the next engine update; tests require complete parameter families after initialization.
limitations: Unity 2022 was tested with an injected callback for command forwarding. Native color/depth/shadow and HZB image tests used the installed Unity 6 binding.
No full-game image/performance equivalence or XR validation.
Actual GPU and Windows Mono Player checks used D3D11; no Vulkan runtime, Android Player or IL2CPP validation in this run.

cross_version_shared_source.package_ownership: One physical package source; validation projects use local UPM file dependencies.

version_boundaries.submission: FRAXINUS_BRG_INDIRECT_API enables the built-in writer on engines with matching bindings. isAvailable reflects the installed submitHandler; an empty handler leaves output untouched.
version_boundaries.native_tracking: Unity.InternalAPIEngineBridge.024 is the common engine-friend identity.
version_boundaries.shadow_apis: UNITY_6000_0_OR_NEWER selects CullShadowCasters and splitIndex; older paths retain splitData.
version_boundaries.editor_apis: Categorization namespace and GraphView override access are selected by Unity version.
version_boundaries.gpu_driven: The existing GPUDriven asmdef requires UNITY_6000_0_OR_NEWER.

limits: Windows D3D11 runtime; shader Vulkan bytecode is not Vulkan execution.
The stock Unity 2022 regression used the default empty binding. A separate dispatch check installed and removed a handler on the same engine.
Unity 6 full-game rendering, performance benchmarks, XR and additional editor versions are not established by these checks.

validation.historical_speedtree_capture_note: The 450-assertion native capture suite was rerun successfully after the naming refactor.

naming_refactor.scope: GPU Batcher C# names only. Serialized field aliases preserve assets; shader identifiers, GPU layouts and resource GUIDs are unchanged.

rules.shared_constants: private const value with a read-only public/internal property

checks: Config.useGPUOcclusionCulling persisted field migrates to the private backing field.
PrototypeData preserves serialized LOD reference size.
Legacy Terrain settings survive renaming and remain addressable by the new Inspector paths.
No public constant fields remain; version and resource identity retain their values.

naming_refactor.player_note: Runtime code was semantically compiled with Unity 2022 and Unity 6 Player defines; previous actual Player reports predate this naming-only change.
naming_refactor.consumer_note: Public property and field names are source API changes, for example GPUBatcherRenderer.Instance -> instance. Package consumers must use the camelCase names.
